entry.title: RES26-205 (Honolulu): PSE → CCL
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF VARIOUS SUPPLIES, EQUIPMENT, AND FOOD, VALUED AT $19,000, TO THE CITY FROM HAWAIIAN LIFEGUARD ASSOCIATION FOR USE BY THE DEPARTMENT OF OCEAN SAFETY TO SUPPORT THE JUNIOR LIFEGUARD PROGRAM, THE OʻAHU JUNIOR GUARD CHAMPIONSHIP, AND THE STATE JUNIOR GUARD CHAMPIONSHIP.

Status: PSE → CCL

Latest action: Committee report and Resolution as amended were adopted.
